feed.title: Open Tools and Research — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 1269 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: Changelog Keeper — Free Self-Hosted Changelog, Release Notes Page and What's New Widget
entry.summary: Publish product updates on a public changelog page with Atom and JSON feeds and an embeddable What's new bell with an unread badge. Scheduled posts, drafts, Slack webhook. Open source, MIT, one-click self-deploy, no monthly fee.

entry.title: Churn Radar — Free Self-Hosted Churn Prediction for SaaS
entry.summary: A free, open-source alternative to ChurnZero and Gainsight for small SaaS: learn from your own usage events which accounts are about to cancel, with an honest out-of-time accuracy check. Paste an export and try it in your browser first.

entry.title: Deal Keeper — Free Self-Hosted Sales Forecast and Pipeline Hygiene
entry.summary: A free, open-source alternative to the forecasting add-ons of Pipedrive, HubSpot and Clari for small B2B teams: win chances learned from your own closed deals, a backtested forecast range and a ranked list of stale or slipping deals. Paste a deal export and try it in your browser.

entry.title: devsec-toolkit — Every DevSecOps Check in One Free, Open-Source Command
entry.summary: One zero-dependency command that runs your repository through 22 open-source DevSecOps checks: GitHub Actions injection and poisoning, Docker and Compose, Kubernetes, dependency confusion, JWT misuse, ReDoS, AI-agent permissions. One report, SARIF for code scanning, baselines. MIT licensed, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Error Keeper — Free Self-Hosted Error Tracking (Sentry Alternative)
entry.summary: A free, open-source alternative to Sentry and Rollbar for small teams: groups the same bug together, alerts on new errors, regressions and spikes, one Node process and one JSON file. Paste stack traces and see the grouping in your browser first.

entry.title: Help Keeper — Self-Hosted Help Center, a Help Scout Docs Alternative
entry.summary: A help center you host yourself: Markdown articles, typo-tolerant ranked search, helpful votes and a report of what visitors searched for and could not find. Open source, MIT, no per-seat fee. Try the search in your browser.

entry.title: ICP Lens — Free Ideal Customer Profile Builder and Lead Scorer
entry.summary: A free, open-source alternative to lead-scoring add-ons: learn your ideal customer profile from your own won and lost list, rank your prospects by lookalike fit with a leave-one-out accuracy check, and draft compliant first outreach on your own AI key. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Internal Link Planner — Find Orphan Pages and Missing Internal Links
entry.summary: Free internal link audit and planner. Drop in your site's HTML files: it finds orphan pages and pages linked only from menus, then suggests the exact sentences in your other pages that should link to them, with the link-equity gain. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: PQL Radar — Free Self-Hosted Lead Scoring for Product-Led SaaS
entry.summary: A free, open-source alternative to MadKudu and Pocus for small SaaS: learn from your own signups which first-week behaviour comes before paying, with an honest out-of-time accuracy check. Paste an export and try it in your browser first.

entry.title: Sign Keeper — Free Self-Hosted E-Signature Links with a Tamper-Evident Audit Trail
entry.summary: Send a signing link, collect a typed signature with consent, and keep a certificate anyone can re-verify. A free, open-source, self-hosted alternative to per-envelope e-signature pricing.

entry.title: Slot Keeper — Self-Hosted Booking Pages, a Calendly Alternative
entry.summary: A booking page you host yourself: weekly hours, buffers, notice, your calendar's busy time respected, time zones, calendar invites, reminders and cancel or reschedule links. Open source, MIT, no per-seat fee. Try the slot finder in your browser.

entry.title: Trade Bid Studio — Price Any Contracting Job and Find Your Walk-Away Number
entry.summary: Free bid calculator for any trade: turn labor hours, materials, subs, overhead and a target margin into a price, your walk-away number, and what a competitor's lower quote actually leaves you. Plus 121 trade-specific bid calculators.

entry.title: Workflow Audit — One GitHub Action That Checks Eleven Workflow Risks
entry.summary: Add one free GitHub Action to scan your workflows for script injection, pwn requests, cache and artifact poisoning, leaked secrets, over-broad permissions and more. Read-only, zero dependencies, SARIF and step-summary output, no network calls.

entry.title: persist-credentials Check for actions/checkout — Find the Artipacked Pattern
entry.summary: Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every actions/checkout step without persist-credentials: false, with jobs that also upload artifacts (the artipacked pattern) listed first. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Cancel Flow — Free Self-Hosted Stripe Cancellation Flow
entry.summary: Keep subscribers who only needed a nudge. A cancellation flow for Stripe that asks why, offers a pause or a discount matched to the reason, and reports your save rate. Preview it in the browser, then run the open-source server in your own account. Free, MIT.

entry.title: Drip Keeper — Free Self-Hosted Lifecycle Email
entry.summary: A free, open-source alternative to Customer.io, Loops and Userlist: your app posts events, sequences send onboarding, trial and win-back email, and a goal event stops the rest. Preview exactly what a person would receive and when, in your browser, then run the server in your own account.

entry.title: Dunning Engine — Free Self-Hosted Stripe Failed Payment Recovery
entry.summary: Recover failed Stripe subscription payments with decline-code-aware retries and emails you control. Preview the recovery schedule for any decline code, then run the open-source server in your own account. Free, MIT, no per-recovery fee.

entry.title: Feedback Board — Free Self-Hosted Feature Requests, Roadmap and Changelog
entry.summary: Collect feature requests, let customers vote, catch duplicates as they type, publish a roadmap and a changelog with RSS. One small open-source server you run yourself. Free, MIT, no per-user fee. Try the duplicate finder in your browser.

entry.title: Flag Keeper — Free Self-Hosted Feature Flags
entry.summary: A free, open-source alternative to LaunchDarkly, Flagsmith and Unleash: percentage rollouts that stay sticky, targeting rules, segments, prerequisites and a kill switch in one small server. Simulate a rollout and see exactly who would flip before you ship it, in your browser.

entry.title: Form Inbox — Free Self-Hosted Form Backend With Spam Scoring
entry.summary: Point any HTML form at your own server: spam scoring with visible reasons, an inbox, CSV export and email or Slack notifications. Open source, MIT, no per-submission fee. Test the spam filter in your browser.
